spec.dom: NOT IN THE LIVE FEATURE SET. No MBP, MBO, book imbalance, slope, resting depth, iceberg, reload, persistence.

carried_forward.labels: label_300s from Phase 35 CSV. REVERSAL vs not. Unresolved counts as not-reversal, same as Phase 35 p_reversal.
carried_forward.first_sweep: earliest eligible sweep on that RTH day (PDH or PDL).
carried_forward.sweep_bar_time: 1m bar open; event known at bar close = open+60s
carried_forward.feature_cutoff_classification: sweep_bar_close = sweep_bar_time + 60. Classification models must not use trades after this timestamp.
carried_forward.news: Eligible sample already excludes full CPI/NFP dates. Strict ±5m around 08:30 never overlaps RTH.

data.schema: Databento GLBX.MDP3 trades (already cached, Phase 35 windows)

trade_signing.method: Databento trades.side aggressor (direct). No quote test, no tick rule, no future quotes.
trade_signing.NONE_N: UNSIGNED — counted in total volume and trade intensity, excluded from ABV/ASV/delta
trade_signing.source: https://databento.com/docs/schemas-and-data-formats/trades : Ask = sell aggressor, Bid = buy aggressor

classification.sweep_60: T inclusive to T+60s inclusive (bar close / confirmation)

diagnostic_may_leak_vs_300s_label.post_60: T+60s exclusive to T+120s inclusive (end of cached window)
diagnostic_may_leak_vs_300s_label.note: These overlap the Phase 35 outcome path (starts at first 1m bar after the sweep bar). They are reported, never used in Models 0-6.

features.reversal_aligned_delta: PDL: delta (buying is positive). PDH: -delta (selling is positive).
features.volume_burst: vol(sweep_60) / max(vol(pre_60), 1.0). Pre-event denominator only. No future-session or same-TOD cross-day median (those data were not cached).
features.flow_efficiency: opposing_aggressive_volume(sweep_60) / max(penetration_points, 0.25). PDL opposing=ASV, PDH opposing=ABV. High = lots of sweep-direction volume for little extension.
features.delta_divergence: 1 if reversal_aligned_ndelta(sweep_60) > 0 else 0. Price made a new extreme by construction; this flags flow already opposing the sweep during the bar.
features.cvd: event-local cumulative signed size (buy +size, sell -size) from first cached trade. Classification uses CVD at cutoff minus CVD at T_open.
features.trade_intensity: trades/sec and contracts/sec in sweep_60; avg and max trade size; burstiness = (n_trades * sum_size^2) / max(sum_size,1)^2 (Herfindahl).
features.flow_flip_diagnostic: 1 if reversal_aligned_ndelta(sweep_60) < 0 AND reversal_aligned_ndelta(post_60) > 0. Uses post-cutoff trades. Diagnostic only.
features.reclaim_delta_diagnostic: reversal_aligned_ndelta from cutoff to Phase 36 1m-close reclaim timestamp, only if reclaim_ts is inside the cached window. Diagnostic only.
features.winsorize: none on raw tables. Logistic z-score uses TRAIN mean/sd only.

spec.primary_universe: first eligible sweep of the day AND shallow (penetration_points <= 18.25) AND usable trades at cutoff

models.method: L2 logistic, TRAIN z-score, no sklearn stack

incremental_gate.conditional_rule: TRAIN-median (or TRAIN 70th for burst) split of a leak-safe flow feature must lift P(reversal) by >= 0.08 on HOLDOUT vs the complementary shallow cell, with the same sign on TRAIN and at least 3 of 4 walk-forward blocks.
incremental_gate.note: A coefficient with the expected sign is not sufficient.

strategy.reuse_phase36: Candidate B geometry: 1m close reclaim, 300s expiry, sweep-extreme stop ±1 tick, 1.5R, next-bar open + 1 tick adverse, $4 RT

spec.note: Phase 37 does not search new sweep rules, does not reopen Phase 35 depth, and does not freeze. If flow adds no stable incremental value: NO_INCREMENTAL_FLOW_VALUE and CLOSE_NQ_SWEEP_RESEARCH_BRANCH.

classification_gate.note: Predeclared Brier gate is Model 6 vs Model 2. Intercept-only is also reported; beating a worse structural model is not by itself an edge.

portfolio_dvp.note: Read-only vs frozen NQ DVP historical trades. No combination.

gc_v2.note: GC paper journal empty. Loss-day overlap undefined.
